facts.business: Msafe Equipments Limited manufactures and rents scaffolding and ladder systems, providing sale of goods, rental services, erection, training, transportation, and dismantling services for construction and industrial projects.
key_risks: Transition from traditional bamboo/mild-steel to modular certified systems
Highly fragmented and rental-led market with unorganised fabricators
Workplace safety compliance and regulatory changes
Raw material price volatility and supply chain disruptions
